design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (finch_circle_rewards, loyalty). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,6]; loyalty_ext_missing_points_credit takes 6, loyalty_ext_card_floor_tier takes 6.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Marisol asks for one thing: points on an online mattress order that did not carry her member number. The scored credit (3159 points) comes out right only if the agent (1) reads in the late-credit rule that the credit is figured at the tier on the membership record and 'is fixed only after the membership record shows at least the Finch Circle tier that an active Marlowe & Finch card status floor grants the member', (2) sees an active Platinum Mastercard (floor Finch Circle Gold) against a record still at Finch Circle Member, (3) applies the owed card floor first, with its own 6-factor alteration-credit top-up, and (4) then works the claim at Gold rates through five more ledger and cross-category ladders. One tool per problem; the difficulty is policy reading, reconciliation of points, card, order, alteration and registry records, and arithmetic.

SCOPE. Task 0 claims loyalty_ext_missing_points_credit (subject loyalty_points_adjustment, on_request, user tool file_missing_points_claim_8cff3bd6) and loyalty_ext_card_floor_tier (subject loyalty_tier_change, state_due, agent tool apply_card_status_floor_f82dd75f). Task 1 claims the courtesy reissue, the return deduction and the note reinstatement. Enrollment and cancellation carry no computation and are claimed by neither. A spend-based mid-year upgrade was dropped: its calendar-year measure cannot be written exactly with rolling-month windows.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root loyalty_ext_missing_points_credit -> loyalty_ext_card_floor_tier, kind value_input (gate earn_rate), form state. Sentence: 'The missing-points credit is fixed only after the membership record shows at least the Finch Circle tier that an active Marlowe & Finch card status floor grants the member.' Four-point test: 'only after'; record-visible state (the tier the record shows, 'at least' so a member already above the floor satisfies it); no tool, id or code token; hard strength. Only the card-floor write brings the record to a card floor tier. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.loyalty_memberships.<mem>.variant_name = Finch Circle Member, last_tier_change_type none; initial_state.card_accounts.<card> Platinum Mastercard, active. Order: floor (step 15) then claim (step 17). Deletion run: without the floor the claim is 2472 instead of 3159 and the tier change and its grant are missing. The floor is a customer-care booking (agent); the claim is the member's own request (user). user_scenario never names a tier, the card floor or alteration credit; the tools validate nothing.

WORLD (charter-producible, simulated rule by rule). Card: opened 2022-08-09 as a Mastercard (closing day 12, grace 25 days). On 2025-09-05 a 3,218.40 handbag charge took its 2025 store spend past the Platinum Mastercard entry spend (3,000.00), so the card charter's mid-year upgrade moved the account to Platinum Mastercard within its business-day allowance (status review date 2025-09-08); the 2026-01-15 annual review on the 2025 spend keeps that status and stamps nothing. A 453.60 coat followed on 2025-11-28. Every billing period with a balance or a transaction has its statement (11 statements, minimum due by the charter's formula), and every statement balance was paid in full by its due date, so the charter produces no interest, no late fee and no returned payment. The mattress (a clearance unit) order's furniture merchandise met the Platinum Mastercard promotional minimum, so the charge carries a 12-month deferred interest plan; it was nonetheless paid in full with the September 2026 statement. Membership: Marisol enrolled on 2026-02-07 after both 2025 purchases (they predate enrollment, so they are unlinked and earned nothing). The base enrollment rule would have started her at the Gold card floor because the card already held Platinum Mastercard; the record shows Finch Circle Member - that missed floor is the state_due tier change this task resolves. Since then: enrollment bonus 500, linked purchases at the Member rate (qualifying spend 168 + 96 + 140 + 89 = 493.00, below the Silver threshold, so no mid-year upgrade is owed), card bonus at 2 per dollar, a bonus event entry on 2026-09-01, one conversion on 2026-07-22 whose note lapsed unredeemed on 2026-09-20. The trousers bought at regular price got a complimentary hem; the blazer sleeve job was charged and paid at the class price. The mattress order (mattress kept, pillow returned in store and refunded to the card) is unlinked.

FACTOR CARD - missing-points credit (baseline: purchase points at the record tier plus bonus event points with the indicator tested on the purchase date, all shares whole, card bonus rate 0 = 1648). Each factor's ladder reads only its own records; the result binding assembles them as the rule's result sentence states:
 event_day_anchor [method, order]: online ship-to-home order -> bonus event looked for on the ship date 2026-09-01, found -> indicator 1 (baseline purchase date -> 2747).
 late_event_share [parameter]: 47 days from the purchase date -> 0.5 (baseline 1 -> 3571).
 price_type_share [parameter, order]: clearance -> 0.5 (baseline 1 -> 3571).
 card_bonus_rate [parameter, card, multi-source]: mf_card AND Platinum Mastercard 2 per dollar -> 2 (baseline 0 -> 2060).
 financing_share [parameter, card]: deferred_interest_12 -> 0.5 (baseline 1 -> 4258).
 card_standing_share [parameter, card, multi-source]: active AND no returned payment within 6 months -> 1 (baseline 0 -> 2060).
 Declared overwrites: the base missing-points credit sentence, the base request sentence (most recent unlinked kept purchase), and the two base earning sentences (purchase/bonus-event points at the purchase-date rate; the separate card bonus entry), each scoped to requests or units this policy handles.
FACTOR CARD - card floor top-up (baseline: floor credit gap, goodwill scale on the days from the floor card's opening, every allowance 0.00 = 75.00):
 goodwill_anchor [method, card]: membership enrolled 2026-02-07 after the card reached Platinum Mastercard on 2025-09-08 -> scale on the days from 2026-02-07, 248 days -> 15.00 (baseline from 2022-08-09 -> 25.00 -> 120.00).
 card_spend_allowance [parameter, card]: charges less credits within 12 months 1,895.40 -> 10.00 (baseline 0 -> 100.00); near-miss: the 2025-09-05 handbag charge is outside the window.
 allowance_standing [parameter, card]: no late fee within 12 months -> 1 (baseline 0 -> 100.00).
 tailoring_allowance [parameter, alteration]: two tickets -> 5.00 (baseline 0 -> 105.00).
 bridal_allowance [parameter, registry]: Wedding Registry event 2026-12-12, 60 days ahead -> 20.00 (baseline 0 -> 90.00).
 apparel_allowance [parameter, order]: three completed apparel purchase records within 12 months -> 10.00 (baseline 0 -> 100.00).
 Every ladder divides the customers reaching a card floor; the floor credit is base plumbing (floor map), not a factor. Declared overwrite: the base top-up sentence, for card floors only.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Floor write: tier_change_active_only (status active, bound to the status argument); loyalty_tier_benefits policy_scope (no points bonus). Claim write: claim_window (purchase 2026-08-27, 60 days, day 47), waiting_period (ends 2026-09-03), not_already_credited (no entry names the mattress).

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Claimed unit: the most recent unlinked unit in completed status (the mattress, order 22573184). Excluded: the returned pillow on the same order, the unlinked 2025 handbag and coat, all linked purchases. The order's card charge carries the 12-month plan; the pillow's credit settles the pillow only.

PERSONA. Marisol opens with the mattress; gives phone, ZIP, DOB, email, order, pillow story, card and registry only when asked; lets the agent bring the membership up to date if told; files the claim herself with the figures given; closes on the credit confirmation.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify (phone, ZIP) -> memberships, points, notes, purchases, order events, returns, card accounts, card transactions, card statements, alteration tickets, alteration charges, registries -> card floor (mem, active, Finch Circle Gold, 110.00) -> member files the claim (mem, mattress, 1099.00, 3159).

VERIFICATION (run). check_compute --task 0: 110.00 and 3159 at handling time; factor baselines 120/100/100/105/90/100 and 2747/3571/3571/2060/4258/2060; whole baselines 75.00 and 1648; skipping the floor gives 2472. check_extended, check_solvability, replay_tasks (closure 65/65), check_grounding - OK.

PROBES (scratch copies). Decoys: a further unlinked completed unit dated earlier -> the latest unit is still the mattress; a closed second card on the other network -> the floor card chain reads only active cards; a closed or second-type registry -> only an active Wedding Registry counts. Absent records: no card on the claimed unit -> card bonus rate 0; no plan -> financing share 1; no dated day -> late share 1 with no event entry; no active floor card -> no card floor (out of scope); no wedding registry -> 0.

REVISIONS. r1 -> r2 (policy audit): (1) undeclared override of the base card-bonus sentence -> two loyalty_evt_points_earn overwrite entries with scoped replaced_by; (2) card-floor ladders with unreachable fall-throughs -> floor credit made base plumbing, standing ladder on late-fee count, delay anchor with three reachable anchors, new bridal allowance; (3) card status review date not producible -> world rebuilt around a 15 January review on 2025 spend and a February enrollment; (4) complimentary hem on a sale item and an off-list sleeve price -> regular-price trousers and the class price; (5) prerequisite sentence widened to 'at least'; (6) claimed unit read as the latest unlinked kept unit. All proof fields, traces and factor records recomputed. r2 -> r3 (audit revision 2): (7) the 2025 card history crossed the Platinum Mastercard threshold mid-year, so the status review date is now the mid-year upgrade date and the history was re-laid by simulating the card charter (statements, minimums, payments in full, no interest or fees); (8) the knife set price was lowered so the year-to-date qualifying spend stays below Silver; (9) the 'most recent unlinked unit' choice is now a declared overwrite of the base request sentence; (10) a hyphen fold in a replaced_by and an unreachable compute guard were removed. r3 -> r4 (render source report): (11) the dating ladder and the bonus-event test were folded into one method factor whose output is the indicator, so no factor reads another's output; the late-claim share is read from the purchase date; a price-type event share replaced the separate event multiplier factor (the mattress is a clearance unit); (12) the delay anchor and the goodwill scale were merged into one method factor and an apparel allowance was added; (13) each policy's result binding now assembles the factor quantities exactly as its result sentence states, and every baseline carries that sentence with the default values.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Vance, a pediatric nurse in Atlanta who has had a Marlowe & Finch Mastercard for years and joined Finch Circle at the Lenox Square store in February; these days you shop mostly online. You are calling on your lunch break, friendly but a little rushed. Late in August you ordered a queen mattress-in-a-box on mfinch.com, and when you checked out you were not signed in, so your Finch Circle number never got attached; you noticed weeks later that no points ever showed up for it in the app. Open the call by saying exactly that: you bought a mattress online at the end of August, your member number was not on the order, and you would like the points for it. You only want the points for that mattress handled today; you are not asking about anything else.
You do not volunteer your details all at once. When the agent asks how to find you, give your mobile number, 4045550137. When asked to confirm your identity, give your billing ZIP code, 30307; if a further detail is wanted, your date of birth is 1984-06-22 and your email is marisol.vance@fastmail.com. Only if the agent asks for the order, read it off your confirmation email: order number 22573184, placed August 27. If the agent asks about the pillow that was on the same order, you say you returned the pillow at the Lenox Square store in September and kept only the mattress, and that the points you are asking about are for the mattress. If asked how you paid, you say you put the whole order on your Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard, the one ending in 2716, on the twelve-month special financing. If asked about a gift registry, you and your fiance, Daniel Okafor, have a wedding registry for December 12. You do not remember your points balance or your tier off-hand and you tell the agent to look it up.
If the agent explains that something on your membership has to be brought up to date before the points can be worked out, you say that is fine and that they can go ahead and take care of it for you; you do not ask what it is worth and you do not suggest anything yourself. Once the agent tells you the claim is ready and hands it over for you to submit, you submit it yourself with exactly the membership, purchase, qualifying amount and points the agent tells you, and you read back what the confirmation says if the agent asks. If the agent quotes you a points figure without having looked at your order, you say you would rather they check it against the order before you submit anything.
When the agent confirms that the points for the mattress have been credited, you thank them, say that is all you needed, and end the call. You never ask for a human, never bring up other purchases, and never name a tier, a card benefit or a points figure yourself.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: Id copied from the find_loyalty_memberships return (the only membership of this customer). Basis: the tool docstring 'the reference number of the Finch Circle membership being changed, as returned by the membership lookup'. Unique: one membership exists for the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.status: Value 'active'. Basis: the docstring 'the membership status as the membership record shows it, which the membership keeps' and the membership record status = active. Unique: suspended and closed describe other states the record does not show; the base gate 'The membership is in active status.' also holds.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_tier: Value 'Finch Circle Gold'. Basis: rule 'When the customer holds a Marlowe & Finch card account in active status whose card grants a higher Finch Circle tier than the membership record shows (Finch Circle Gold for a Store Card Elite or a Platinum Mastercard, Finch Circle Platinum for a World Elite Mastercard), the membership is moved to that floor tier as a card floor'. prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the card floor (step 15) strictly precedes the claim (step 17).
